prompt.en: A friend is trying a simple cardboard model and would welcome company. What would you most like to do?
prompt.zh: 朋友在试做简单纸板模型，也欢迎有人一起，你最想做什么？

label.en: Join them for the next small step so they do not have to figure it out alone.
label.zh: 加入下一个小步骤，不让对方独自摸索。

label.en: Ask which part matters most before deciding what I can commit to.
label.zh: 先问哪部分最重要，再决定自己能承担什么。

label.en: Suggest a version that leaves room for my own visual choices.
label.zh: 提一个能保留自己视觉选择的版本。

label.en: Turn one confusing part into a playful demonstration we can try.
label.zh: 把一个难懂部分变成可一起试的趣味演示。

prompt.en: An optional workshop offers several roles, but you cannot take them all. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 可选工作坊提供几种分工，你无法全接，更愿意怎样选？

label.en: Choose the role that connects with a responsibility I actually want to take.
label.zh: 选择和自己真愿承担的责任相连的分工。

label.en: Pick the role that lets me keep a distinctive personal approach.
label.zh: 选能保留鲜明个人做法的分工。

label.en: Try a role that lets me explain or reframe something for newcomers.
label.zh: 试一个能给新人解释或换角度说明的分工。

label.en: Work on one practical technique I would enjoy getting more familiar with.
label.zh: 练一种自己愿意逐渐熟悉的实际做法。

prompt.en: A shared illustration project asks everyone to use one style. What would attract you most?
prompt.zh: 共同插画项目请大家用一种风格，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Find a detail that can still express my own taste within the agreement.
label.zh: 在约定里找仍能表达自己口味的细节。

label.en: Show a playful alternative that helps people see the idea differently.
label.zh: 展示一个趣味替代，让大家换角度看想法。

label.en: Practise a small part of the agreed technique until it feels more workable.
label.zh: 练约定技法的一小部分，直到更顺手。

label.en: Clarify the wording of the instruction so nobody reads it as a personal criticism.
label.zh: 说清说明的措辞，免得被读成对人的批评。

prompt.en: Someone understands the instructions but cannot picture the next step. Which contribution appeals most?
prompt.zh: 有人看懂说明却想象不出下一步，你最想贡献什么？

label.en: Make a quick, unexpected example that shows another way to see it.
label.zh: 做个迅速、意想不到的例子，展示另一种看法。

label.en: Demonstrate the small movement slowly and let them try it themselves.
label.zh: 慢慢示范小动作，再让对方亲手试。

label.en: Check which words are unclear and replace them with a concrete description.
label.zh: 问哪些词不清楚，换成具体描述。

label.en: Work alongside them for the next attempt, if they would like company.
label.zh: 如果对方愿意，就陪着一起做下一次。

prompt.en: You have ten minutes to explore a new paper-folding technique. What would feel most satisfying?
prompt.zh: 有十分钟探索新折纸做法，什么最让你满足？

label.en: Repeat one small fold and notice what makes it easier to control.
label.zh: 重复一个小折法，留意怎样更好控制。

label.en: Find a short, careful explanation that avoids a misleading instruction.
label.zh: 找一段简短、仔细、不会误导的说明。

label.en: Try it beside someone else so we can help each other through the awkward bit.
label.zh: 和别人并排试，互相帮过不顺手的部分。

label.en: Decide which part is worth my limited time before beginning.
label.zh: 开始前决定哪部分值得投入这点时间。

prompt.en: A group is about to post a short announcement about its hobby work. What would you most like to check?
prompt.zh: 小组要发一则兴趣成果短通知，你最想核对什么？

label.en: Whether the words say what we mean without putting pressure on someone.
label.zh: 文字是否讲清原意，又不对某人施压。

label.en: Whether someone needs a hand finishing the small practical step before posting.
label.zh: 发出前是否有人需要帮忙完成一个实际小步骤。

label.en: Whether I am comfortable with the part of the plan I have agreed to own.
label.zh: 自己是否愿意承担已经约好的那部分计划。

label.en: Whether my contribution still sounds like a choice I made for myself.
label.zh: 自己的贡献是否仍像亲自选的表达。

prompt.en: A newcomer is trying a hobby task that most of the group already knows. What would you prefer to offer?
prompt.zh: 新人在试小组多数人已熟悉的兴趣任务，你更愿意提供什么？

label.en: A little company while we work through the first attempt together.
label.zh: 第一次尝试时陪一陪，一起做过去。

label.en: A clear offer of the part I can help with, without promising everything.
label.zh: 明确说能帮哪部分，不承诺包办全部。

label.en: Permission to choose a version that feels like their own, as I would want.
label.zh: 像自己也希望的那样，让对方能选有自己味道的版本。

label.en: A playful demonstration that makes the unfamiliar part less mysterious.
label.zh: 一个趣味示范，让陌生部分没那么神秘。

prompt.en: Two small projects ask for your help on the same afternoon. What would you most like to do first?
prompt.zh: 两个小项目都在同一下午请你帮忙，你最想先做什么？

label.en: Think through which commitment I can genuinely keep and tell people plainly.
label.zh: 想清能真做到哪项承诺，再明白告诉大家。

label.en: Choose the contribution in which I can express something I care about.
label.zh: 选能表达自己在意之处的贡献。

label.en: Find a different format that may let the group approach the work more flexibly.
label.zh: 找一种不同形式，也许能让小组更灵活地做。

label.en: Select one concrete skill-sized task I can focus on practising.
label.zh: 选一项大小明确、可以专心练的具体任务。

prompt.en: You are invited to decorate a shared notebook cover. What would appeal most?
prompt.zh: 有人请你装饰共同笔记本封面，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Make one visual choice that I can honestly say is mine.
label.zh: 作一个自己能坦然认领的视觉选择。

label.en: Play with an unusual example that changes how the cover could work.
label.zh: 试一个不寻常例子，改变封面的可能做法。

label.en: Spend time getting one line or small shape steadier.
label.zh: 花时间把一条线或一个小形状做稳一点。

label.en: Choose wording that makes the shared purpose clear without claiming to speak for everyone.
label.zh: 选能讲清共同用途、又不冒充代表所有人的措辞。

prompt.en: A practice session feels stuck because everyone is explaining the task the same way. What would you choose?
prompt.zh: 练习卡住了，大家一直用同一种办法解释，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Invent a different example that lets people look at it from a fresh angle.
label.zh: 编一个不同例子，让大家换角度看。

label.en: Break one part into a small repetition that can be tried directly.
label.zh: 把一部分拆成可以直接重复试的小练习。

label.en: Ask which phrase is being misunderstood and make it more precise.
label.zh: 问哪句话被误解，再说得准确些。

label.en: Join someone for an ordinary attempt rather than leave them watching alone.
label.zh: 陪一个人实际做一次，不让对方只是独自在旁看。

prompt.en: After one imperfect attempt at a craft, what would you most enjoy trying next?
prompt.zh: 手作第一次不完美，接下来最想试什么？

label.en: Repeat the particular movement that I want to become more familiar with.
label.zh: 重复自己想更熟悉的那个具体动作。

label.en: Describe what happened carefully before deciding how to ask for feedback.
label.zh: 先仔细描述发生什么，再决定怎样请人反馈。

label.en: Have another go alongside a willing friend and help each other.
label.zh: 和愿意的朋友一起再做一次，互相帮一帮。

label.en: Check whether this is still a task I want to spend time on today.
label.zh: 确认今天是否仍想把时间放在这项任务上。

prompt.en: A helpful suggestion could easily sound harsher than intended in a message. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 一条本想帮忙的建议，写成消息容易比原意生硬，你更愿意怎么做？

label.en: Say exactly what I noticed and ask whether suggestions are welcome.
label.zh: 说清具体看见什么，再问是否欢迎建议。

label.en: Offer to try the next small part together instead of only commenting.
label.zh: 不只评论，提议一起试下一个小部分。

label.en: Be clear about what help I am actually willing and able to provide.
label.zh: 说清自己真愿意、真能提供什么帮助。

label.en: State my preference as my own rather than making it a rule for them.
label.zh: 把偏好说成自己的选择，不变成给对方的规则。

prompt.en: Your group has one unfinished prop for a casual performance. What contribution would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 轻松表演还差一个道具没做完，你更愿意贡献什么？

label.en: Join the person finishing it and take the next manageable piece of work.
label.zh: 加入正在做的人，接下一块可完成的工作。

label.en: Agree on the part I can take responsibility for and where it stops.
label.zh: 约清自己负责哪部分，以及做到哪里为止。

label.en: Keep a personal design detail that makes my part feel chosen.
label.zh: 留一个让自己这部分有亲自选择感的设计细节。

label.en: Try a playful substitute that changes how the prop could be used.
label.zh: 试一个趣味替代，换一种道具用法。

prompt.en: An invitation assumes you will take the same role you took last time. What would you most like to do?
prompt.zh: 一次邀请默认你还会接上回的角色，你最想怎样回应？

label.en: Choose deliberately whether I want that responsibility again.
label.zh: 认真决定自己是否还愿接这项责任。

label.en: Say which version or role I would actually prefer for myself.
label.zh: 说清自己真正喜欢哪个版本或角色。

label.en: Suggest a different arrangement that lets people discover another approach.
label.zh: 提另一种安排，让大家发现不同做法。

label.en: Pick a bounded practical part that I would like to practise more.
label.zh: 选一块范围明确、还想多练的实际部分。

prompt.en: A shared hobby piece is becoming polished but no longer feels like your contribution. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 共同兴趣作品越来越精致，却不太像自己的贡献了，你最想做什么？

label.en: Explain the particular personal choice I would like to keep visible.
label.zh: 说明自己想保留可见的那个具体选择。

label.en: Show an unexpected alternative that may open the piece up again.
label.zh: 展示一个意想不到的替代，也许重新打开作品。

label.en: Work carefully on a specific detail I still enjoy making.
label.zh: 认真做自己仍喜欢制作的一处细节。

label.en: Find words that explain the concern without making it an accusation.
label.zh: 找能说明顾虑、又不构成指责的说法。

prompt.en: You can help explain a simple technique to willing beginners. What sounds most appealing?
prompt.zh: 可以给愿意的新手讲一个简单技法，你最喜欢什么？

label.en: Use an imaginative comparison, then let people test whether it helps.
label.zh: 用一个想象比较，再让大家试是否有用。

label.en: Practise the demonstration beforehand so the small action is easier to see.
label.zh: 提前练示范，让小动作更容易看清。

label.en: Choose concise words that describe the action without judging the learner.
label.zh: 用简明词语描述动作，不评价学习者。

label.en: Work next to someone for a first try and follow their pace.
label.zh: 陪一个人第一次试，跟着对方节奏。

prompt.en: A hobby skill has one detail you cannot yet do the way you intend. What would you most like to try?
prompt.zh: 某项兴趣技能有个细节，暂时做不成自己想要的样子，你最想试什么？

label.en: Give that one detail a short, deliberate round of practice.
label.zh: 给那个细节一轮短而专注的练习。

label.en: Ask a specific question that makes the difficulty easier to understand.
label.zh: 问一个具体问题，让困难更容易说清。

label.en: Invite a willing partner to try the step with me.
label.zh: 请愿意的伙伴陪自己试这个步骤。

label.en: Check how much of my time I want to commit to this today.
label.zh: 确认今天愿意给它投入多少时间。

prompt.en: Someone asks you to write a short note on behalf of a project. What would you prefer to do?
prompt.zh: 有人请你代表项目写一张短便条，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Check what I can accurately say and avoid adding an unintended promise.
label.zh: 确认能准确说什么，不添无意中的承诺。

label.en: Ask who needs practical support after the note is sent.
label.zh: 问便条发出后，谁还需要实际支持。

label.en: Clarify whether I am agreeing to the responsibility that the note implies.
label.zh: 说清是否同意便条暗含的那项责任。

label.en: Keep my own voice where the group has left room for it.
label.zh: 在小组留出的空间里保留自己的声音。

prompt.en: A friend is nervous about joining a harmless creative trial. What would you most like to offer?
prompt.zh: 朋友对参加无害的小创作尝试有些犹豫，你最想提供什么？

label.en: Company for one small, optional first attempt.
label.zh: 陪一次小小、可选的初次尝试。

label.en: A clear account of what I can help with and what remains their choice.
label.zh: 讲清自己能帮什么、哪些仍由对方选择。

label.en: Space to adapt the trial to a style they would actually choose.
label.zh: 给调整为对方真愿意选择的风格留空间。

label.en: A playful way to look at the trial as an experiment rather than a performance.
label.zh: 用趣味角度把尝试看作小实验，而非表演。

prompt.en: Your available time changes halfway through an optional project. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 可选项目做到一半，可用时间变了，你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Renegotiate the part I can responsibly continue instead of silently promising too much.
label.zh: 重新约定能继续负责哪部分，不默默答应过多。

label.en: Choose which personal contribution I still want to keep in the smaller version.
label.zh: 选出缩小版本里仍想保留的个人贡献。

label.en: Reframe the plan so the group can see a different workable route.
label.zh: 换个框架，让小组看到另一条能走的路。

label.en: Focus on a small technique-sized piece that can still be practised well.
label.zh: 专注一块虽小、仍可认真练的具体技法。

prompt.en: You can choose a theme for your own page in a collaborative zine. What attracts you most?
prompt.zh: 合编小刊中，自己的那页可自选主题，你最被什么吸引？

label.en: A choice of subject and style I would genuinely like to stand behind.
label.zh: 一个主题与风格都真愿认领的选择。

label.en: An unusual example that invites readers to see the theme differently.
label.zh: 一个邀请读者换角度看主题的特别例子。

label.en: A chance to refine one practical aspect of how the page is made.
label.zh: 一个打磨页面制作具体做法的机会。

label.en: A way to phrase the page so its meaning is clear and considerate.
label.zh: 一种让页面意思清楚又体贴的表达。

prompt.en: A group has treated one hobby method as the only way to begin. What would you prefer to contribute?
prompt.zh: 小组把一种兴趣做法当成唯一入门方式，你更愿意贡献什么？

label.en: A different demonstration that people can compare without committing to it.
label.zh: 另一个可自由比较、不必承诺采用的演示。

label.en: A short practice step that makes the existing method easier to try.
label.zh: 一个让现有方法更好试的短练习步骤。

label.en: A careful explanation of what the method does and does not require.
label.zh: 仔细说清这种方法要求什么、不要求什么。

label.en: A friendly offer to attempt the first part alongside anyone who wants company.
label.zh: 友好提议，愿意有人陪的可以一起做第一部分。

prompt.en: There is one extra practice round before a voluntary creative showcase. What would you most enjoy?
prompt.zh: 自愿创作展示前还有一轮额外练习，你最喜欢做什么？

label.en: Repeat a specific technique and notice one small adjustment.
label.zh: 重复一个具体技法，留意一处小调整。

label.en: Refine the words introducing the work so they promise no more than it does.
label.zh: 打磨介绍措辞，不承诺作品做不到的东西。

label.en: Help a willing partner through the next attempt while doing my own.
label.zh: 自己也做的时候，陪愿意的伙伴过下一次尝试。

label.en: Decide which responsibility I can still take on comfortably.
label.zh: 决定自己还愿意接哪项责任。

prompt.en: Before sharing a group project publicly, what would you most like to make clear?
prompt.zh: 共同项目公开分享前，你最想说清什么？

label.en: What the message means, whom it represents and whether those people agree.
label.zh: 消息是什么意思、代表谁、那些人是否同意。

label.en: Who would like a hand with the next small step of sharing.
label.zh: 谁希望在分享的下一个小步骤里有人帮一把。

label.en: Which follow-up commitments I have actually chosen to accept.
label.zh: 自己实际选择接受了哪些后续承诺。

label.en: Which part of the contribution expresses a choice that is personally mine.
label.zh: 哪部分贡献表达的是属于自己亲自作的选择。
